decisions.P01: Requested symbols use FILL 0 by default; solid playback/stop/pause, record, trophy, success and speaker-off use FILL 1. Upvote includes both states. All labels are examples for localized owners, never runtime vector descriptions.
decisions.P02: Reply and Backspace mirror in RTL. Vertical directions, fixed media transport and all other new artwork do not. Original mirroring is unchanged.
decisions.P03: USB and hearing aid use iOS cable.connector and ear.badge.waveform. Android-only drag indicator uses iOS line.3.horizontal as an explicit portable fallback. Requested xmark.bubble is absent from the Apple catalog; dismiss_question explicitly uses iOS13 xmark.circle. Optional labelled whiteboard/browser/Q&A controls remain text-only.
